# Pytest files that repo-checks runs on every backend-affecting PR, outside test
# selection. List a test here when its input is the whole INSTALLED_APPS import
# graph (startup import budget, receiver baseline), so any file in the repo can
# break it while the diff touches nothing it appears to own. Product isolation
# and draft narrowing skip the Django suite for exactly such diffs, which is how
# a product-only PR turned master red without a single failing check.
# Only list tests that pass with no Postgres, ClickHouse, or Redis available:
# repo-checks runs without service containers.
